programme.title: E5
programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

Born in Yamaguchi Prefecture in 1897, Tama moves to Tokyo and rekindles her childhood dream of becoming a writer. Through disasters, war, turbulent relationships, and financial struggles, she remains true to herself and forges her own path, eventually becoming a celebrated novelist whose life and work inspire generations.

programme.title: E40
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E36
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多、敖子逸、王晨藝、黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台、合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合。

programme.title: E51
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: E31
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: E5 - Rhino
programme.desc: At 9 years of age Kifaru is already a well-travelled Southern White Rhino. He was born in New Zealand at Hamilton Zoo as part of their Rhino breeding programmed. Then in 2014, at five years of age, he was moved across the Tasman Sea to Australia to the National Zoo and Aquarium. After four years in the country’s capital zoo, it’s time for him to move again. This time, getting him into the transportation crate is not easy but the team are ready with plans A – Z.

programme.title: E5 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

Then in 2014, at five years of age, he was moved across the Tasman Sea to Australia to the National Zoo and Aquarium. After four years in the country’s capital zoo, it’s time for him to move again. This time, getting him into the transportation crate is not easy but the team are ready with plans A – Z.

programme.desc: Coyote dehorns a white rhino and implants a GPS tracker into a rare black rhino!

programme.title: E5 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.title: The Inspector Wears Skirts
programme.desc: Police Superintendent Wu is in charged with the duty of organizing Hong Kong's first all women police action squad. At first, her style of training is too harsh for the girls who are used to dates and dances. She is able to gain their respect and obedience eventually. The leader of the men's squad, Kan, falls for Wu and he has the most hilarious way of showing his love towards her. Wu's top shooter and fighter help her give the girls some fine tuning such as walking on fire. Their first real assignment finally arrives when they, along with the men's squad, are sent to guard a jewelry exhibition. The robbers capture both Wu and Kan in a shoot-out...

programme.title: Body Weapon
programme.desc: A brutal murder occurs in the moonlight: a masked killer and his two accompanies execute a couple in an extremely sadistic way. Organized crime investigators KWAN, LEE and LING start to investigate into the case promptly. LING has a charming character and both men are in love with her. LING faces a dilemma and decides to give both men a fair competition. No sooner have they resolved the love triangle that they face great disasters. On the wedding night of LING and LEE, three masked killers break into their house, slay LEE and force LING to engage in S. M...

programme.title: BB30
programme.desc: Bau is a poor lawyer who has never won in litigation. He is a righteous guy but his unstable character brings him under disciplinary investigation, during which he meets a beautiful doctor, Cheng. However, since Cheng often deposes against Bau, misunderstanding and conflict grow between the two. On the other hand, Susan, an aerobic dancing instructor, has a deep passion for Bau for a long time and this makes Mo feel jealous and determine to go against him. As Bau and Mo go together, troubles and laughers are stirred up...

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sandra Ng
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer?

programme.title: Saving General Yang
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father...

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: My Small Land
programme.desc: For Sarya (17), a Kurdish refugee girl in Japan, life seems to be looking up; her grades at school are enough to pursue college, she's surrounded with good friends and her relationship with Sota is becoming special. Sarya's life becomes upside down, however, when she learns that her family's refugee status is turned down, restricting her family from work and traveling across the city. Her father, who had continued to work to sustain a living, is taken into custody for illegal employment. Sarya is now suddenly forced into a situation where she is responsible not only for her younger siblings but for her very existence.
